scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.db:psql: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml exec db psql -U threejs_user -d threejs_database
scripts.db:seed:test: docker compose -f db/docker-compose.yml exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U threejs_user -d threejs_test < db/seed.test.sql
